The equation ([\[eq:equivariance_correct\]](#eq:equivariance_correct){reference-type="ref" reference="eq:equivariance_correct"}) guarantees that the symmetry of the hidden spin-½ particles is perfectly converted into the standard symmetry of the physical spin-1 particles we observe.
